data.narrative:
Herasight is a seed-stage biotech & health company founded by Michael Christensen that has raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage peers in the biotech & health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Chai Discovery.

Only one triangulation method proved applicable: stage-progression analysis. Using the $5M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of the Seed-to-next-stage transition, this approach implies a valuation of $12M. Peer-median analysis could not be performed—while 8 same-sector peers exist, none met narrow same-stage or adjacent-stage filters, and a broad sector median would introduce substantial noise. Public-comp anchoring using the sector's 6.6x P/S median is inapplicable without disclosed target revenue.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This range reflects a conservative 15% sensitivity band around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the lack of revenue data (preventing multiple valuation cross-checks), the thinness of near-peer data at seed stage, and reliance on a generic stage multiplier rather than target-specific growth metrics. Additional diligence on capital efficiency and market positioning would be required to refine this estimate.
